name: Laurentian Highlands (Laurentides)

geo.extent: North shore of the St. Lawrence and Ottawa valleys, Georgian Bay to the Atlantic

description: The southern edge of the Canadian Shield, rising abruptly above the St. Lawrence Lowlands along their north-west border from Georgian Bay to the Atlantic. Rounded forested hills and countless lakes north of Montréal and Québec city, with ski hills such as Mont Tremblant (968 m) and Mont Sainte-Anne (800 m); Mont Raoul-Blanchard (1,181 m) is the highest of the Laurentians.

attributes.physiographic_level: Laurentian Region of the Canadian Shield
